run_per_block_rss_profiling: run the per-block RSS profiling script to diagnose peak RAM regression during quantization
run_rss_profiling_old_arch: run the per-block RSS profiling script with AR_DISABLE_NEW_ARCH=1 to profile the old architecture
measure_live_rss_mb: measure the current process RSS in MB using psutil without garbage collection
measure_rss_mb_clean: measure the current process RSS in MB after running gc.collect and malloc_trim
review_block_rss_log: review the per-block RSS log entries showing delta_return and delta_trim memory changes per quantization block
